title: Server side rendering: being able to trigger the search server side
body:
Feature request

**What is the current behavior?**

Currently when rendering a react-instantsearch page with [next](https://zeit.co/blog/next) it doesn't send a page with results already fetched from Algolia.

**What is the expected behavior?**

It would be great if this could be achieved without any configuration. Otherwise, it would be enough to provide a guide that explains how to do it (and change the API or the internals to make it possible, if needed).
